name: Luxury House by Zoom Travel
description:
About this propertySpacious Accommodation: Luxury House by Zoom Travel in Baku offers a spacious apartment with one bedroom and two bathrooms. The property is pet-friendly and includes a terrace and balcony.

Modern Amenities: Guests enjoy free WiFi, air-conditioning, a washing machine, and a fully equipped kitchen. Additional facilities include a sauna, TV, and a hot tub.

Convenient Services: The apartment provides free bicycles, a free airport shuttle service, and a 24-hour front desk. Private check-in and check-out, a tour desk, and a minimarket are also available.

Prime Location: Located 25 km from Heydar Aliyev International Airport, the property is near attractions such as Maiden Tower (less than 1 km) and Flame Towers (2 km). An ice-skating rink is in the surroundings.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
